description: File patterns to match for deletion in purge-junk-files skill
notes: Each pattern supports Windows wildcards: * (any chars), ? (single char)

Numeric suffix files: *.[0-9][0-9]*.* requires at least 2 consecutive digits in a segment, e.g. myprogram.283091287.p or report.20250315.w — avoids false positives like '8.1d-01 Job Processing Guide.doc'
exclude: file-level wildcard patterns that are never deleted regardless of pattern matches
Windows Explorer copies: '* - Copy.*' matches 'foo - Copy.p'; '* - Copy (*.*' matches 'foo - Copy (2).p'; 'Copy of *.*' matches 'Copy of foo.p'
Add or remove patterns as needed for your project
